personalInfo.title: Full Stack Web Developer
personalInfo.profile: Accomplished Full Stack Web Developer with 3+ years of progressive experience specializing in high-impact frontend architecture and robust full-stack integration. Driven by a focus on optimal user experience (UX) and frontend performance, actively contributed to scalable application design, ensuring user-friendly, cross-platform interfaces and seamless communication across microservice architectures. Expertise leverages modern frameworks including Nuxt, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript, delivering clean, maintainable code within Agile SCRUM environments.

responsibilities: Successfully created and launched over 50 fully responsive websites from provided design specifications, accurately translating complex visual layouts into functional code, ensuring an optimal user experience across all devices.
Led the content migration process from legacy client websites, guaranteeing the seamless transfer and data integrity to the new platform, thereby maintaining service continuity for clients.

Developed multiple internal tools and scripts that significantly streamlined the site styling process and partially automated content migration, resulting in increased development efficiency and faster project delivery.
Supported the project's planning and roadmap execution, providing insights on frontend architecture and collaborating with the team to resolve potential development challenges.

Enhanced user satisfaction and engagement by developing a user-friendly and responsive interface for the web application, focusing on frontend performance and optimizing it for various devices and platforms.

Played a key role in delivering a scalable and resilient application by collaborating in the design of the microservice architecture, focusing on frontend integration and ensuring seamless communication between services.
Facilitated data exchange and integration by designing, implementing, and consuming REST APIs, improving communication between front-end and back-end systems.
Accelerated project completion by collaborating with multiple technology stacks, infrastructures, and cross-functional teams to develop comprehensive web applications.
Contributed to the successful launch and maintenance of multiple web applications by planning, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining features, ensuring reliability and user satisfaction.
